app_name: Restaurant app (working name until the friend's handoff arrives)
what_it_does: A branded ordering and loyalty app for one restaurant: direct pickup and delivery orders without delivery-app commission, a loyalty club or digital punch card, push notifications and coupons, one-tap reorder, and pre-orders for Shabbat and holidays.
who_it_is_for: Independent restaurants, cafés, bakeries and small local chains with regulars, especially ones that get a real share of their orders through Wolt or 10bis.
good_signs: Listed on Wolt or 10bis (pays commission on every order)
Busy, with many reviews or a loyal crowd (regulars to move into the app)
Active Instagram or Facebook with deals or a weekly menu
Already runs a punch card, club or WhatsApp list (values loyalty)
bad_signs: Already has its own branded app (check the name + 'אפליקציה')
Part of a national chain or franchise (decided at HQ)
Already runs a Tabit club app or similar
Possibly closed, temporary or seasonal pop-up
Event catering only (rare orders; pitch a website instead)
pitch_he: אפליקציה ממותגת למסעדה: הזמנות ישירות בלי עמלה, מועדון לקוחות והזמנה חוזרת בהקשה אחת.
price_note: First-year estimates per restaurant type are in lead_agent/data/app_types.json (setup + 12 months). Never put prices in openers.
source: Provisional, from the App Client Map research (24 Nov 2026). Replace with the friend's handoff when it arrives; ask the user before committing details from it (the repo is public).
